ruling.eventDescription: One CBP customs ruling: ruling number, subject, date, issuing office, the HTS codes Customs assigned in both CROSS and tariff-schedule notation, precedent status flagging whether it was revoked or modified and by which ruling, USMCA and NAFTA flags, and links to the ruling page and source document. First 3 rows per run are free.

ruling_full_text.eventDescription: Everything in a ruling row plus the complete ruling body: the product description CBP worked from, its reasoning, and the classification it reached. Costs an extra upstream request per ruling. First 3 rows per run are free.
